sources.title: Gray1237.svg
sources.author: Rhcastilhos, after Henry Vandyke Carter / Gray plate 1237
sources.license: Public domain; PD-self with worldwide any-purpose fallback grant
sources.review: Actual original and extracted palms rendered and visually inspected. Blood vessels, bones and labels removed; retained original surface contour and skin creases. Does not supply neurological regions.

sources.title: Hand pointing down (contour).svg
sources.author: Clker-Free-Vector-Images, Pixabay ID 40445
sources.review: Actual preview is a downward pointing gesture with folded digits, not a complete open palmar surface.

sources.title: Hand.svg
sources.author: Kieff / LucasVB (current 2009 outline); original uploader Kenny sh
sources.review: Complete open outline actually viewed, but generic silhouette lacks palmar surface detail. Gray source better suits teaching display.

sources.title: Hand parts - en.svg
sources.author: Fred the Oyster; derivative HombreDHojalata; translations by Commons contributors
sources.review: Actual preview shows nails and label back: dorsal surface, not a palm.

sources.title: A clinical review of hand manifestations of cervical myelopathy, cervical radiculopathy, radial, ulnar, and median nerve neuropathies
sources.author: Jajeh et al.
sources.review: Distinguishes cervical roots from radial/ulnar/median peripheral nerves; not permission to commercially adapt its diagrams.

sources.title: Surface Anatomy and Sensory Evaluation of Dermatomes: A Guide for Residents
sources.author: Balamurugan Rajendran et al.
sources.review: Table2 contains key sensory test points; Figure1 caption identifies schematic key points, adapted from ASIA. Direct figure image could not be retrieved during this run; no claim of visual inspection of that figure. Such points are not closed complete palmar C6/C7/C8 boundaries.

sources.title: Anatomy, Skin, Dermatomes
sources.author: Patrick A. Whitman, Marjorie V. Launico, Oluwaseun O. Adigun
sources.review: C6 thumb, C7 middle finger, C8 little finger landmarks do not constitute area polygons. Its Figure1 independently credits Grant_1962_663.png; copyright jurisdiction checked separately.

sources.title: Anatomy, Medial Antebrachial Cutaneous Nerve
sources.author: Ballard, Black, Smith
sources.license: Not used for copied or derivative assets
sources.review: This URL is a peripheral medial antebrachial cutaneous nerve entry, not a complete palmar spinal-root atlas. Forearm sensory nerve descriptions cannot be renamed C6/C7/C8 polygons.

sources.title: Grant 1962 663.png
sources.author: John Charles Boileau Grant; uploader Cmdrjameson (not the medical author)
sources.review: Commons explicitly warns about copyright in jurisdictions including Mainland China; StatPearls public-domain label is insufficient for this commercial deployment.

sources.title: Dermatomes labeled, male front/back 3d-shaded.svg
sources.author: Goran_tek-en; RobHurt information contributor
sources.review: Original hand details actually rendered. Existing verified source-map identifies anterior hand composite C6-C8 and C8/T1 areas, not separate complete palmar C6/C7/C8 polygons. Dorsal fingertip patches cannot be transplanted onto palmar surface. No splitting or invented continuation.
